name: ktc-production-control-desktop
description: KTC Production Control Desktop - A+B theo tháng, báo cáo theo công đoạn, pending chạy lại từ dữ liệu DB mới nhất
author: KTC

scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix ../frontend run build && npm run copy:frontend
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:frontend && npm run smoke:excel && electron-builder --win portable nsis --x64
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build:frontend && npm run smoke:excel && electron-builder --win portable --x64
scripts.dist:nsis: npm run build:frontend && npm run smoke:excel && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.check: node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/companyExcelLocal.cjs && node --check electron/excelDualLayout.cjs && node --check electron/monthlyWorkbookLocal.cjs && node --check scripts/smokeExcel.cjs
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build:frontend && npm run smoke:excel && electron-builder --win dir --x64
